characterization_methods.key_findings: Fe0.75Mn0.25Al is metallic (nonzero DOS at the Fermi level); a sharp DOS peak at the Fermi level is dominated by hybridized Fe-d and Mn-d states with weak Al-p; asymmetric up/down spin channels indicate magnetic character.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Energy range -10 to 20 eV; dashed Fermi level at 0 eV; partials Al-s, Al-p, Fe-d, Mn-d in up/down spin channels
characterization_methods.purpose: Analyze chemical bonding characteristics and electronic structure
characterization_methods.technique: Spin-polarised total and partial density of states (TDOS/PDOS)

characterization_methods.key_findings: Elongated contours along Al-Fe, Al-Mn and Fe-Mn bond axes indicate covalent interactions; delocalized electrons indicate metallic bonding; combination of covalent and metallic bonds (weaker covalent effect).
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: 2D contour maps on crystallographic slices (e.g. (011) and (110) planes); colour bars in contour-value units
characterization_methods.technique: Total electron density distribution and electron density difference contour maps

Thermodynamic stability evaluation (per-atom total energy minus bulk cohesive energies)
Determination of polycrystalline bulk modulus B, shear modulus G, Young's modulus E and Poisson's ratio sigma from elastic constants
analytical_models.model_note: VRH is stated to be the best method for evaluation of mechanical properties of polycrystalline materials.

analytical_models.equation_role: Estimate Vickers hardness H_V from shear modulus and Pugh's modulus ratio k = G/B
Quantify elastic anisotropy (A^U, A_B, A_G, A1 = A2 = A3)
analytical_models.model_note: If all indexes are zero the structure is isotropic; deviations from zero show anisotropy.

analytical_models.equation_role: Calculate longitudinal, transverse and average sound velocities and Debye temperature from B, G and density

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Cubic supercell, space group Pm-3m; 8x8x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff; total energy converged to 2x10^-6 eV; force on each atom < 0.5 eV/nm
computational_details.potential_model_or_database: GGA-PBE exchange-correlation; ultrasoft pseudopotentials; valence states Fe 3d^6 4s^2, Mn 3d^5 4s^2, Al 3s^2 3p^1
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Calculated lattice parameters show good agreement with other experimental and calculated values; slight deviation attributed to differences in calculation methods and experimental conditions.

processing_steps.method: DFT geometry optimization and property calculation using CASTEP with GGA-PBE
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Ultrasoft pseudopotentials; GGA-PBE exchange-correlation; 8x8x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff; total energy converged to 2x10^-6 eV; force on each atom reduced to 0.5 eV/nm. Valence states: Fe 3d^6 4s^2, Mn 3d^5 4s^2, Al 3s^2 3p^1.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: DFT single crystal, cubic Pm-3m supercell
measurement_conditions.test_standard: Voigt-Reuss-Hill (VRH) approximation for polycrystalline moduli (Eqs. 4-9); Vickers hardness via empirical model Eq. 10

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Formation enthalpy via Eq. (2); cohesive energy via Eq. (1)
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: DFT total-energy calculation on optimized crystal structure

measurement_conditions.test_standard: Universal anisotropic index A^U (Eq. 11), bulk/shear anisotropy A_B and A_G (Eqs. 12-13), shear anisotropic factors A1 = A2 = A3 (Eq. 14)
Debye temperature and sound velocities via Eqs. (15)-(18)

electrical_properties.electronic_conductivity: good electronic conductivity (qualitative; metallic bonding with nonzero DOS at the Fermi level)

magnetic_properties.magnetic_character: magnetic (dissymmetric spin-up and spin-down states in spin-polarized TDOS)

phases_present.crystal_structure: B2-type cubic, space group Pm-3m; optimized lattice parameter a = b = c = 0.574 nm

structures.overall_structure: Cubic B2-type (FeAl parent) supercell with space group Pm-3m; 16-atom cell (8 Al on one simple-cubic sublattice, 8 Fe/Mn on the other sublattice), with Mn substituting Fe (2 Mn sites for x = 0.25).

unmapped_findings: Fe0.75Mn0.25Al is classified as ductile by the B/G criterion: its B/G ratio of 1.91 exceeds the 1.75 threshold, whereas FeAl (1.56) and Fe0.875Mn0.125Al (1.75) are brittle (b0045).

In the reported descending anisotropy order, Fe0.75Mn0.25Al ranks between Fe0.375Mn0.625Al and Fe0.25Mn0.75Al: MnAl > Fe0.5Mn0.5Al > Fe0.625Mn0.375Al > Fe0.125Mn0.875Al > Fe0.375Mn0.625Al > Fe0.75Mn0.25Al > Fe0.25Mn0.75Al > Fe0.875Mn0.125Al > FeAl (b0059).
Fe0.75Mn0.25Al satisfies the cubic mechanical stability criteria (C11-C12 > 0, C11 > 0, C44 > 0, C11+2C12 > 0), confirming it is mechanically stable (b0033, b0034).

For Fe0.75Mn0.25Al, the band from -5 to 1 eV is dominated by Al-p, Fe-d and Mn-d states; near the Fermi level the Fermi surface arises mainly from Fe-d and Mn-d states with low Al-p hybridization (b0028).

The Fig. 4 electron-density panels are captioned only as 'Fe Mn Al-(011)' and 'Fe Mn Al-(110)' without explicit composition subscripts; the panel pair (c)/(d) is assumed to correspond to Fe0.75Mn0.25Al by lettering convention, but this is not explicitly stated in the caption (b0043, figure_004).
